fields.title: Why are the leaves on this window plant splitting?
fields.answer: This is a Monstera deliciosa. Holes and splits in mature leaves are a normal adaptation, not insect damage; bright indirect light helps new leaves develop stronger fenestration.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated close view of a Monstera leaf with natural fenestrations beside a window
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Photographed by the library window; compare the next new leaf with the older growth.

fields.title: How do ramen shops keep the egg yolk perfectly jammy?
fields.answer: Lower a chilled egg into boiling water for about six and a half minutes, then move it straight into ice water. Peel it and refrigerate it in a light soy, mirin, and water marinade.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated ramen bowl showing a halved egg with a jammy yolk
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Tested during Monday ramen night; six and a half minutes came closest to the restaurant texture.

fields.title: Why does this similar-triangles problem still need one more condition?
fields.answer: One pair of equal corresponding angles is not enough to establish similarity. Prove a second pair of equal angles, or add two pairs of corresponding sides in proportion, before applying a similarity criterion.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated study reference showing a similar-triangles geometry sketch
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: A missed question from evening study; I treated “it looks similar” as if it were a criterion.

fields.title: Why does a cut apple turn brown so quickly?
fields.answer: Once the flesh meets air, polyphenol oxidase helps oxidize phenolic compounds into brown pigments. Lemon juice slows the reaction through both acidity and vitamin C.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated reference showing freshly cut apple slices beginning to brown
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Noted while packing fruit for lunch; toss the slices with a little lemon juice next time.

fields.title: What is the key difference between mitosis and meiosis?
fields.answer: Mitosis usually makes two genetically similar diploid cells for growth and repair. Meiosis uses two divisions to make four genetically varied haploid cells.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated biology reference comparing mitosis and meiosis
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Biology quiz review; remember division count, final cell count, and chromosome number.

fields.title: What does “Except bicycles” mean on a road sign?
fields.answer: It means bicycles are exempt from the restriction above it. For example, “No entry except bicycles” bars other vehicles while allowing bicycles through.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated street-sign reference illustrating an except-bicycles exemption
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Seen while cycling to school; the noun after “except” names the exemption.

fields.title: How can I tell basil and mint apart quickly?
fields.answer: Smell a leaf first: mint has an obvious cooling note, while basil leans toward clove and pepper. Then look at the leaf edge; mint is usually more deeply serrated, and basil leaves are rounder and softer.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated side-by-side reference of basil and mint leaves
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Noted while volunteering at the community garden; scent is more reliable than leaf shape alone.

fields.title: Why does bread dough usually proof twice?
fields.answer: The first rise develops flavor and a gas-holding gluten structure. After shaping, the second rise lets fresh, smaller bubbles lift the loaf evenly for a finer crumb.
fields.image_alt: AI-generated baking reference showing bread dough during proofing
fields.media_credit: AI-generated reference image for this App Store preview.
fields.source_note: Recorded after a first batch of dinner rolls; under-proofing stays dense, while over-proofing can collapse.
